actions: device/sysfs metadata and existing GPIO value only; no export/request/direction/output writes
command:
set -eu
echo META_START; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; cat /proc/uptime
echo CHARACTER_DEVICES
for p in /dev/gpiochip*; do test -e "$p" || continue; stat -c '%n %t:%T %u:%g:%a' "$p"; done
echo SYSFS_CHIP120
for n in label base ngpio; do p=/sys/class/gpio/gpiochip120/$n; if test -r "$p"; then echo "$n"; cat "$p"; fi; done
echo EXPORTED_GPIO125
for n in direction active_low value; do p=/sys/class/gpio/gpio125/$n; if test -r "$p"; then echo "$n"; cat "$p"; else echo "ABSENT_$n"; fi; done
echo DEBUGFS_GPIO
if test -r /sys/kernel/debug/gpio; then awk '/gpiochip/ || /gpio-125[^0-9]/ {if(++n<=100)print} END {print "SELECTED",n+0}' /sys/kernel/debug/gpio; else echo GPIO_DEBUGFS_UNREADABLE; fi
echo META_END; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; cat /proc/uptime
